svg.title: How streamrag answers a question
svg.desc: The question "How does request collapsing prevent cache stampedes?" goes to keyword and vector search. Keyword search finds two posts, vector search six results. Reciprocal rank fusion puts the two posts both lists found first. A cross-encoder reranks the top 30, which moves two more posts about caching up from further down. The top six become numbered sources, and the model writes an answer that cites them. Reworded and asked again: from the cache in 39 ms.
